theater: 斯摩棱斯克走廊與維德羅沙河

battle.name: 第二次莫斯科-立陶宛戰爭
battle.theater: 斯摩棱斯克走廊與維德羅沙河
battle.brief: 一五〇〇年春天，莫斯科大公伊凡三世以立陶宛干預諾沃哥羅德開戰，斯摩棱斯克同年七月城破，維亞澤馬與北方諸城相繼易手。一五〇一年一月，莫斯科軍在維德羅沙河擊潰奧斯特羅格斯基率領的立陶宛軍，但因疫病與糧秣不足未能深入。一五〇二年訂成五十年休戰。輪發槍只配軍官與親衛，用於哨戒與近身射擊。

kit.name: 輪發槍
kit.history: 最早的後膛手槍。機械太貴，只給火槍隊的軍官與衛兵。

countries: 這場戰爭的交戰方看來是兩個國家，實際是一條自北而南的鑲嵌式邊界。北方是莫斯科大公國：大公伊凡三世以「炮匠院」統一管理火砲、火藥與火器匠，軍隊骨幹是成建制的弓箭手中隊與火槍射手，貴族與軍頭則各自率領披甲侍從隊作戰，決策集中在伊凡三世與大公書房之間，與立陶宛那種由樞密院和大貴族共同分擔的體制截然不同。南方是立陶宛大公國：亞歷山大·雅蓋隆以維爾納為首都，靠拉齊維盧斯家族的樞密院運作；國家軍隊以立陶宛與白俄羅斯貴族的重騎兵為主軸，輔以波蘭弓手與僱來的德意志（普魯士、里加）砲手、萊茵蘭的步兵傭兵，這些德籍傭兵隊長在火器與築城技術上往往比本國貴族更有話語權。立陶宛並非獨力作戰：利沃尼亞騎士團與條頓騎士團的邊境軍、來自波蘭王室的現金與使節、以及維普斯公國沿線的軍需供應，都站在維爾納一方；波蘭王亞歷山大本人則以中立調解人的身分往返於兩國之間。莫斯科的北方戰線還包括被吞併的諾沃哥羅德與普斯科夫：兩城的貴族與商會被押往莫斯科，議會制度與城防被拆毀，武器庫被收繳，本地青壯年被編入大公的常備兵。這是一場以火器、城堡與冬季補給為核心的邊疆爭奪，而不是兩支大軍的正面會戰。
countriesEn: The two sides look like two states, but in truth this was an enclave border running from north to south. In the north was the Grand Duchy of Moscow: Grand Prince Ivan III centralised cannon, powder and gunsmiths in the artillery yard, the backbone of his army was made up of formed bands of archers and matchlock firearms, and boyars and captains each led their own armoured retinues into the field, while decisions were taken by Ivan III and his private chancery, a system quite unlike the shared council and magnate government of Lithuania. In the south was the Grand Duchy of Lithuania: Alexander Jagiellon ruled from Vilnius through a council dominated by the Radziwill family; the national army had as its axis the heavy horse of the Lithuanian and Belarussian nobility, supported by Polish archers and by hired German gunners and foot soldiers from Prussia, Riga and the Rhineland, and these German captains of mercenaries often had more to say about firearms and fortification than native nobles did. Lithuania did not fight alone: the frontier forces of the Livonian and Teutonic Orders, cash and envoys from the Polish court, and the supply line running along the Duchy of Prussia all stood on the Vilnius side; King Alexander of Poland himself moved between the two countries as a neutral mediator. The northern front of Moscow included the annexed republics of Novgorod and Pskov: their nobles and merchant communities were marched off to Moscow, their assemblies and defences were dismantled, their arsenals were seized, and their young men were conscripted into the grand prince's standing forces. This was a border struggle fought with firearms, fortresses and winter supply, not a set-piece battle between two great armies.
people: 最關鍵的人物當然是莫斯科大公伊凡三世。他不僅是發動戰爭的人，更是把「收復家產」寫成國際法義的人：一四九四年斯摩棱斯克王公一支投奔莫斯科後，他宣稱立陶宛所奪去的羅斯王公采地（世襲領地）應歸大公國所有，於是斯摩棱斯克成為開戰的藉口。他的妻索菲亞·帕列奧略格娜出身拜占庭皇族，在這場衝突中扮演了教會與頭銜的推手：她要求被稱為「沙皇」，並主張莫斯科都主教區的人選應由她與大公決定，用以對抗維爾納與基輔的天主教勢力對羅斯教會的影響。伊凡的長子瓦西里三世此時以羅斯托夫公爵的身分在軍中效力，繼承大公位後將把這場戰爭的成果制度化。北線的圍城由伊萬·舒伊斯基主持，他率軍包圍諾沃哥羅德，編年史記載該城總督在圍城期間被殺，市政廳與議會隨後被拆散；另一路由安德烈·斯塔羅杜布與丹尼爾·謝尼亞率領，前者在維德羅沙河戰役中鋒線得手，後者指揮中央縱隊突破立陶宛左翼，德米特里·沃洛奇克等人則參與斯摩棱斯克方向的攻勢。立陶宛方面，大公亞歷山大·雅蓋隆在戰爭初期親政，戰局失利後於一五〇一年去世，其弟齊格蒙特一世繼承大公位並兼並波蘭王位；前線統帥康斯坦丁·奧斯特羅格斯基是白俄羅斯最有力的貴族，維德羅沙河一敗後退保普斯科夫，米哈伊爾·沃羅廷斯基等人則在樞密院中主導談判。伊凡三世之女葉蓮娜嫁予波蘭王兼立陶宛大公亞歷山大，使莫斯科得以用王朝關係影響維爾納的決策，而條頓與利沃尼亞騎士團的使節則是五十年休戰的主要穿線人。
peopleEn: The decisive figure was of course Ivan III, Grand Prince of Moscow. He was not only the man who started the war but also the one who dressed it in the language of old law: after a branch of the Rurikid princes of Smolensk fled to Moscow around 1494, he proclaimed that the appanages of the Rus princes held by Lithuania belonged by right to the grand prince, and Smolensk became the pretext for the war. His wife Sophia Palaiologina, descended from the Byzantine imperial house, was the driver of the ecclesiastical and titulature issues: she demanded to be styled tsaritsa and claimed that the appointment of the metropolitan of Moscow should be made by her and by the grand prince, which meant Moscow confronting the Catholic influence over the Rus church centred on Vilnius and Kiev with claims of its own. Ivan's elder son Vasili III served in the army in this period as Prince of Rostov and would turn the results of the war into institutions once he succeeded to the grand princely throne. The siege in the north was directed by Ivan Shuisky, who led the army that invested Novgorod; the chronicles record that the city's voivode was killed during the siege, after which the offices of the posadnik and the veche were broken up. Another column was led by Andrey of Starodub and Daniil Shchenya, the former striking in the line at the battle of the Vedrosha and the latter commanding the central column that broke the Lithuanian left, while men such as Dmitry Volchok took part in the operations towards Smolensk. On the Lithuanian side Grand Duke Alexander Jagiellon governed in person at the opening of the war and, after the reverses, died in 1501, his brother Sigismund I succeeding him as grand duke while also holding the crown of Poland. The field commander was Konstanty Ostrogski, the most powerful magnate of Belarusia, who after his defeat on the Vedrosha fell back into Pskov, while men such as Mikhail Vorotynsky led the negotiations in the council. Ivan III's daughter Elena was married to Alexander Jagiellon, king of Poland and grand duke of Lithuania, which allowed Moscow to influence Vilnius's decisions through dynastic channels, and the envoys of the Teutonic and Livonian Orders were the men who carried the fifty-year truce through.
kits: 這場戰爭的火器骨架是「火繩火槍、弓、弩、長矛」四件套。莫斯科方面稱長身火槍為「皮什恰爾」那樣的大口徑火繩鎗，射手隊伍中仍大量使用弓矢，後來成為獨立兵種的「射手」即源於此；立陶宛方面則以重騎兵、長柄騎槍與波蘭式長矛為主，並靠德意志砲手操作野戰重砲，圍城則用大砲射程與掘進挖壕並行。莫斯科在十五世紀末已能自鑄大砲，克里姆林宮兵器庫現存一門標為一四五六年的大砲就是證據，其「炮匠院」專門登記、修理與分發火器，這套制度在戰爭中成為吸收外來技術的關鍵。卡面這件輪發槍在這個時點還是極新的東西：機構約在一五〇〇年前後出現於低地國家，以鋼輪撞擊燧石、靠發條上弦，免火繩但上弦要轉十幾圈，機件怕潮、耗藥多、價錢是火繩手槍的數倍。它在戰役裡的位置很窄：實際上只出現在兩類人手上，一是大公、軍隊首領與親衛隊長的侍從，二是隨立陶宛大公作戰的德意志傭兵隊長。它能在夜哨與宿營警戒時隨手擊發，也能在對方高級軍官單挑時派上用場，貴族陣亡時常把手槍與佩劍一同帶走；但它從來不是會戰的決定力量，維德羅沙河那樣的決鬥靠的是縱隊縱深、火槍齊射與騎兵衝鋒。除火器外，兩軍的後勤同樣決定成敗：牛車與騾車組成的車隊運糧運彈藥，冬營靠徵用與掠奪維生，沒有戰地醫院，只有隨軍的草藥師與巫醫；通信全靠信使與驛站，命令往往在傳遞中失真；至於攻城，最終還是要靠大砲射程、城牆厚度與攻城季節來決勝負。
kitsEn: The firing skeleton of this war was the four-part kit of matchlock firearms, bows, crossbows and pikes. The Muscovites called their long-barrelled matchlock guns pishchali, and archery was still massed in their shooter bands, the streltsy out of which the separate estate of arms of the sixteenth century would grow; the Lithuanians relied on heavy horse, long cavalry lances and Polish-style pikes, with German gunners operating field artillery, and sieges were conducted with heavy pieces, sapping and trenches worked in parallel. Moscow could already cast heavy guns of its own by the end of the fifteenth century, as the great cannon dated 1456 in the Kremlin Armoury shows, and its artillery yard kept the registers, the repairs and the issue of weapons, a system that became the hinge for absorbing foreign technique during the war. The wheellock pistol on the card was still an extremely new object at this moment: the mechanism had appeared in the Low Countries around 1500, a steel wheel striking pyrite and a wound spring cocking it, needing no match but requiring a dozen or more turns of the crank, vulnerable to damp, thirsty for powder and costing several times a matchlock pistol. Its place in the campaign was narrow: in practice it was held only by two kinds of men, the personal attendants of the grand prince, of army commanders and of captains of the guard, and the German mercenary captains who campaigned with the Lithuanian grand duke. It could be discharged at a sentry post or during night watch, and it came in handy when an enemy commander of high rank was challenged to single combat, and nobles were often buried with their pistols and swords still on them; but it was never the deciding instrument of a battle, and a clash like the Vedrosha was settled by the depth of the column, massed volleys and the charge of the cavalry. Beyond the firearms, the logistics of both armies decided as much as the shooting did: trains of ox carts and mule wagons carried grain and powder, winter camps lived off requisition and plunder, there was no field hospital, only camp herbalists and sorcerers; communications ran entirely on messengers and relay stations, and orders were often distorted in transit. As for siege work, in the end it was the range of the heavy guns, the thickness of the walls and the season of the year that decided the outcome.
tactics: 作戰方式上，兩邊都不是近代會戰，而是多路分進、冬季攻坚與騎兵縱隊的古典模式。一五〇〇年春，莫斯科主力沿斯摩棱斯克大道推進，輔以指向維亞澤馬的一支，北方則由舒伊斯基圍困諾沃哥羅德，同時對普斯科夫施壓逼其服從；這種分進合擊的安排，說明莫斯科的目標一開始就是消滅對方在北方的共和制度，而不是一決雌雄的會戰。斯摩棱斯克圍城自六月中起，大砲射擊與壕溝掘進並行，切斷城內水源與糧道，七月十四日城破。真正的會戰發生在一五〇一年一月二十日：丹尼爾·謝尼亞與安德烈·斯塔羅杜布率軍渡過西德維納河，在維德羅沙河一線遇上康斯坦丁·奧斯特羅格斯基的立陶宛軍。立陶宛軍依慣例以騎兵為先鋒在冰面展開，但封凍的河面既吃不住重騎兵的衝鋒，也讓縱隊無法展開，莫斯科軍趁其受制，以密集縱隊正面撞開左翼，隨即以兩翼迂迴包抄，騎兵在冰上失去衝力，全軍潰散，營帳、火砲與輜重盡為敵所得，奧斯特羅格斯基退保普斯科夫。此後莫斯科軍越過邊界深入立陶宛境內，攻破並燒毀維爾納近郊的梅德尼卡伊堡壘，但嚴冬與一五〇一年的疫病造成大量減員，糧秣與冬裝不足，軍隊不得不退回；一五〇二年另一支莫斯科軍推進至涅曼河畔而止，隨後雙方開始談判。立陶宛一方則利用莫斯科的病亡與缺糧收復部分邊城，戰爭的主動權就此易手。
tacticsEn: In method, neither side fought a modern battle: the pattern was the classical one of converging columns, winter siege and cavalry charge. In the spring of 1500 the main Muscovite column advanced along the Smolensk road, supported by a thrust towards Vyazma, while in the north Shuisky invested Novgorod and pressure was put on Pskov to make it submit; that arrangement of divided advances shows that the Muscovite object from the start was to destroy the republican institutions of the north rather than to win a single decisive engagement. The siege of Smolensk began in the middle of June, with cannon fire and sapping carried on together and the city's water and supply routes cut, and the city fell on 14 July. The real battle came on 20 January 1501: Daniil Shchenya and Andrey of Starodub led their troops across the Western Dvina and came upon Konstanty Ostrogski's Lithuanian army on the Vedrosha. The Lithuanians followed custom and deployed the cavalry as van on the frozen surface, but the frozen river would not carry the shock of heavy horse and did not allow the columns to deploy; the Muscovites took advantage of their constraint, struck the left wing frontally with close-packed columns and then enveloped both flanks, the cavalry lost its charge on the ice, the whole army broke, tents, guns and baggage fell to the enemy, and Ostrogski retired into Pskov with a few hundred riders. The Muscovites then crossed the frontier and drove deep into Lithuanian territory, storming and burning the castle of Medininkai near Vilnius, but the severe winter and the epidemic of 1501 caused heavy attrition, and with food and winter clothing in short the army had to fall back; in 1502 another Muscovite column advanced to the banks of the Nemunas and stopped there, and negotiations opened. The Lithuanian side used the Muscovite sickness and want of food to recover some border fortresses, and the initiative in the war changed hands accordingly.
data: 可核對的數字集中在時間與地點上。一四九七年《莫斯科條約》劃定伊凡三世與立陶宛的邊界，兩年後開戰。一五〇〇年七月十四日，斯摩棱斯克在約三周的圍城後陷落；同年，維亞澤馬歸附莫斯科，北方諾沃哥羅德在夏季陷落，普斯科夫則在一五〇〇至一五〇一年間交出鑰匙並按伊凡的要求自行拆毀城牆，其議會與大鐘直到一五一〇年才被正式廢除與運走。維德羅沙河之役的日期為一五〇一年一月二十日（舊曆），換算新曆是三十日；莫斯科編年史宣稱此役立陶宛軍陣亡一萬、俘虜甚眾，但近代研究普遍認為實際陣亡在數百至數千之間，可以確定的是立陶宛全軍的火砲、輜重與營帳被奪，統帥奧斯特羅格斯基僅以數百騎退入普斯科夫。軍隊規模方面，兩軍主力都被記為以數萬計：莫斯科是步卒為主的混合大軍，立陶宛則是騎兵比例更高、附帶大量僱傭兵與砲手的貴族軍，具體數字各方記載互相矛盾，不宜採信。戰爭以一五〇二年的五十年休戰收束：合約在莫斯科達成，隨後在一五〇三年維爾納的集會上確認，並就普斯科夫的貢賦爭議另訂協議。往後的時序也印證了這次休戰的脆弱：一五〇三年起莫斯科屢次支持利沃尼亞騎士團南下破約，一五一二年的第三次莫斯科—立陶宛戰爭爆發，一五一四年奧爾沙之役立陶宛獲勝，斯摩棱斯克重回立陶宛之手。
dataEn: The verifiable figures cluster around times and places. The Treaty of Moscow of 1497 drew the frontier between Ivan III and Lithuania, and the war broke out two years later. On 14 July 1500 Smolensk fell after a siege of about three weeks; in the same year Vyazma submitted to Moscow and Novgorod fell in the north in the summer, while Pskov handed over its keys between 1500 and 1501 and pulled down its own walls at Ivan's demand, its veche and great bell not formally abolished and removed until 1510. The battle of the Vedrosha is dated 20 January 1501 in the old calendar, which is 30 January in the new. The Muscovite chronicles claimed ten thousand Lithuanian dead and many prisoners in that battle, but modern scholarship generally puts the dead in the hundreds or the low thousands; what can be credited is that the whole of the Lithuanian artillery, baggage and tents were taken and that the commander Ostrogski withdrew into Pskov with a few hundred riders. As for the size of the armies, both main forces are recorded as numbering in the tens of thousands: Moscow's was a mixed mass army with the foot in the majority, Lithuania's was a noble army with a higher proportion of horse, hired mercenaries and gunners, and the specific figures in the sources contradict one another and cannot safely be used. The war was closed by the fifty-year truce of 1502: the agreement was reached at Moscow and confirmed at a diet in Vilnius in 1503, with a separate settlement over the disputed tribute of Pskov. The later chronology also shows how brittle that truce was: from 1503 Moscow repeatedly broke it by supporting the Livonian Order against Lithuania, the third Muscovy-Lithuania War broke out in 1512, and at Orsha in 1514 the Lithuanians won, Smolensk returning to Lithuanian hands.
cause: 打起上來的直接原因是斯摩棱斯克的王位與繼承糾紛。一四九四年前後，斯摩棱斯克一支羅斯王公後裔投奔莫斯科，伊凡三世隨即援引「羅斯諸王公采地應歸大公國」的古老說法，宣稱立陶宛侵占的斯摩棱斯克、維亞澤馬等領地必須歸還，戰爭的藉口就此成立。教會問題同樣關鍵：索菲亞·帕列奧略格娜要求以「沙皇」自居並要求掌握莫斯科都主教區的提名權，這意味著莫斯科要在羅斯教會的管轄上直接對抗以維爾納與基輔為中心的天主教勢力；立陶宛支持的東方教區分裂在這幾年裡成為庫利科沃之後東正教世界的又一次撕裂。北方共和國的地位是第三條導火線：一四九七年伊凡三世與諾沃哥羅德訂約將其置於莫斯科的宗主權之下、一四九八年廢除其議會並運走大鐘之後，立陶宛方面的貴族與使節一直以讓人宣誓效忠大公的名義干涉諾沃哥羅德與普斯科夫的從屬問題，莫斯科則指控立陶宛違約、縱容反對派。宏觀上，一四九七年《莫斯科條約》對邊界與采地歸屬的文字含糊，伊凡三重整軍備、集中火砲、推行專制集權之後，已經具備了單方面改變現狀的實力；又逢一四九七至一五〇二年條頓騎士團在波羅的海與立陶宛交戰、立陶宛被牽制的空檔，開戰的時機就此成熟。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the fighting was the dispute over the succession to Smolensk. Around 1494 a branch of the Rurikid princes of Smolensk fled to Moscow, and Ivan III at once invoked the old doctrine that the appanages of the Rus princes belonged to the grand prince, declaring that Smolensk, Vyazma and the other lands held by Lithuania had to be returned; the pretext for the war was thus established. The ecclesiastical question was equally central: Sophia Palaiologina demanded the style of tsaritsa and the right to control the appointment of the metropolitan of Moscow, which meant Moscow confronting, in the governance of the Rus church, the Catholic force centred on Vilnius and Kiev, and the East-West church split supported from the Lithuanian side deepened once again in these years, after Kulikovo. The status of the northern republics was the third fuse: after Ivan III's treaty with Novgorod in 1497, which placed it under Moscow's suzerainty, and the abolition of its veche and the removal of its great bell in 1498, Lithuanian nobles and envoys had gone on interfering in the question of the subjection of Novgorod and Pskov by making men swear loyalty to the grand duke, and Moscow accused Lithuania of breaking the treaty and of harbouring the opposition. On the larger scale, the wording of the 1497 Treaty of Moscow about the frontier and the ownership of appanages was ambiguous, and once Ivan III had reorganised the army, concentrated the artillery and tightened his autocratic rule, he had the strength to change the situation unilaterally; and since the Teutonic Order was fighting Lithuania in the Baltic between 1497 and 1502 and Lithuania was therefore tied down, the moment to strike had arrived.
impact: 這場戰爭的直接結果，是北方的兩個羅斯共和國制度就此終結。諾沃哥羅德在圍城與屠掠之後被拆散議會、沒收財產，貴族與商人被押往莫斯科充當役人，許多家族就此在北俄扎下根來；普斯科夫在交出城防後又撐了十年，最終在一五一〇年失去議會與自治。莫斯科由此取得大量北方人力與賦稅，把原本與大公國平行的共和政體併入中央集權的框架，這是羅斯國家形成的關鍵一步之一。領土上，莫斯科一度取得斯摩棱斯克與維亞澤馬，獲得第聶伯河上游的關鍵渡口與出海口方向，但一五一四年奧爾沙之役後又全部失去，說明這條邊界仍靠軍力硬撐。宗教與民族版圖上的裂痕同樣被這場戰爭固定下來：一五〇〇年利沃西夫「安息大教堂」教會在波蘭王室與都主教約瑟夫推動下成立，成為統一教會運動的起點，羅斯土地上的東正教與東方禮天主教分界此後長期是東歐政治的暗線，最終在一五九六年的布列斯特聯盟公開化。技術面上，戰爭把火砲、築城與外來砲手帶進了莫斯科的制度：「炮匠院」的登記與修理制度成型，伊凡三世時期興建的石砌塔樓與稜堡式防禦建築成為北方邊防的骨架，冬季渡河、雪地宿營與野外勤務的經驗也沉澱在軍制裡。外交上，莫斯科越過休戰線支持利沃尼亞騎士團，立陶宛則在羅斯境內扶植反對派王位繼承人，雙方的行為邏輯一致：只要邊界未定，任何喘息都會被利用，於是五十年休戰從簽訂之日起就注定短命。
impactEn: The direct result of the war was the end of the two Rus republics in the north. Novgorod, after its siege and plunder, had its assembly broken up and its property confiscated, its nobles and merchants were marched off to Moscow to serve as unfree labour, and many families were thereby rooted in the northern country; Pskov survived for another ten years after surrendering its defences and finally lost its veche and its autonomy in 1510. Moscow thereby gained large numbers of northern men and taxpayers and folded a republican polity that had run parallel to the grand principality into the frame of centralisation, one of the decisive steps in the formation of the Russian state. In territory Moscow won Smolensk and Vyazma for a time, gaining the key crossing points of the upper Dnieper and the direction of the sea, but it lost them all again after Orsha in 1514, which shows that this frontier was still being held by military force alone. The religious and ethnic fissures of the region were likewise fixed by this war: the Dormition church at Lviv was founded in 1500 with the patronage of the Polish crown and of the metropolitan Joseph and became the starting point of the Uniate movement, and the division of the Rus lands between the Orthodox and the Byzantine-rite Catholics remained a hidden line of East European politics for a long time, only made public by the Union of Brest in 1596. On the technological side the war carried cannon, fortification and foreign gunners into the institutions of Moscow: the register-and-repair system of the artillery yard took shape, the stone towers and bastion-style works of the Ivan III period became the skeleton of the northern frontier, and the experience of winter crossings, snow camps and field duty settled into the practice of the army. In diplomacy Moscow went over the line of the truce to support the Livonian Order, and Lithuania fostered rival claimants to the Muscovite throne inside Russia; the logic on both sides was the same — as long as the frontier was undecided, every respite would be exploited — and the fifty-year truce was therefore doomed from the day it was signed.
result: 打完之後，局勢並沒有真正安定。一五〇〇至一五〇二年，北方線上莫斯科完勝，諾沃哥羅德與普斯科夫先後落入控制；中部線上莫斯科也一度得手，斯摩棱斯克與維亞澤馬易主，立陶宛在維德羅沙河一戰全軍被破；但深入立陶宛本土的行動被嚴冬、疫病與糧秣不足中止，莫斯科軍最遠只到涅曼河一帶就折返，沒能在立陶宛境內建立任何可持續的據點。結果由一五〇二年的五十年休戰確認：邊界大致停在西德維納河與第聶伯河之間，斯摩棱斯克在莫斯科手中維持到一五一四年，普斯科夫的貢賦另立條款，諾沃哥羅德的處置則未再提及。休戰很快名存實亡：一五〇三年起莫斯科支持利沃尼亞騎士團侵入立陶宛，立陶宛則在羅斯境內扶植王位競爭者，第三次莫斯科—立陶宛戰爭於一五一二年間爆發，一五一四年奧爾沙之役立陶宛重奪斯摩棱斯克，一五一六年莫斯科軍在第聶伯河沼澤中的洛帕斯納幾近全滅。從更長的視角看，這場戰爭標誌著立陶宛的生存線從「立陶宛—魯塞尼亞聯邦」退向民族較為同質的立陶宛本土，也標誌著莫斯科把自己放在了「第三羅馬」的位置上，取代羅斯諸公國去對抗天主教的立陶宛—波蘭聯邦；兩者之間長達半個多世紀的邊界戰爭，由這次失敗的停火開始，一直延續到一五六九年盧布林聯盟把魯塞尼亞各省併入波蘭、以及一五五八年起的波羅的海戰爭把立陶宛拖入另一個戰場為止。
resultEn: After the fighting the situation was not truly settled. Between 1500 and 1502 Moscow won outright on the northern line, with Novgorod and Pskov falling one after another into its hands; on the central line it also had its moments, with Smolensk and Vyazma changing hands and the Lithuanian army broken at the Vedrosha; but the advance into Lithuanian territory proper was halted by the severe winter, the epidemic and the shortage of food and clothing, and the Muscovite army turned back after reaching only the banks of the Nemunas, establishing no sustainable foothold in Lithuania at all. The outcome was confirmed by the fifty-year truce of 1502: the frontier came to rest roughly between the Western Dvina and the Dnieper, Smolensk stayed in Muscovite hands until 1514, the tribute of Pskov was settled by a separate clause, and the disposition of Novgorod was not mentioned again. The truce was soon nominal: from 1503 Moscow supported Livonian raids into Lithuania, Lithuania fostered pretenders to the Russian throne, and the third Muscovy-Lithuania War broke out in the years around 1512; at Orsha in 1514 the Lithuanians retook Smolensk, and in 1516 the Muscovite host was practically annihilated in the marshes of the Dnieper at Lopasna. Seen from further back, this war marks the point at which Lithuania's line of survival retreated from a Lithuanian-Rusenia federation towards a more ethnically homogeneous Lithuanian core, and the point at which Moscow placed itself in the position of the Third Rome, taking on the Rus princes' role of opposition to a Catholic Lithuanian-Polish union. The border war between them, begun with this failed ceasefire, ran on until the Union of Lublin in 1569 folded the Ruthenian provinces into Poland and the Livonian War from 1558 dragged Lithuania into a different theatre.
